QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripServerConnectEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Connect to the NTRIP caster at the host address and port that are set
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Connect to NTRIP caster

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripMountpoint
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Name of the caster's mountpoint to receive corrections from. NTRIP does not connect without one.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Mountpoint

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripUseTls
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Connect to the caster with TLS 1.2 or later. The caster must offer TLS on that port.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Use TLS encryption

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripAllowSelfSignedCerts
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Allow connections to NTRIP casters with self-signed TLS certificates. Disabling this rejects self-signed certificates to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Accept self-signed certificates

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripGgaPositionSource
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Position reported to the caster. Network (VRS) mountpoints need it; Auto selects the best available source.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Position source for NMEA GGA sentences sent to the NTRIP caster. Auto selects the best available source.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Auto,Vehicle GPS,Vehicle EKF,GNSS receiver,Ground station position
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: GGA Position Source

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripGgaIntervalSec
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: How often the position is reported to the caster.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: How often to send NMEA GGA sentences upstream to the NTRIP caster. VRS mountpoints typically require 1-10s; set lower for tighter VRS tracking, higher to reduce bandwidth.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: GGA Send Interval

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripVersion1Casters
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Casters that take NTRIP version 1 requests only
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: NTRIP version 1 casters

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripFailoverEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Go on to the saved casters when this caster cannot be reached
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When the caster that is entered cannot be reached or stops serving, connect to the saved casters in turn instead of retrying it alone. A wrong login or mountpoint of the entered caster still stops the connection.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Fall back to saved casters

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripRequireVehicle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Connect only while a vehicle is connected
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Wait with the NTRIP connection until a vehicle is connected, and end it 10 seconds after the last vehicle is gone.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Connect only with a vehicle

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripDataCapMB
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: End the connection after this much data from the caster; 0 for no limit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: End the NTRIP connection once this many megabytes have arrived from the caster since it was connected, across reconnects. 0 sets no limit. The count starts again with Connect or Retry and is not kept when the application is closed.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Data limit
